description: Replace the list of ordered milestones under the goal (2–6, or up to 6 per track), each countable (metric and target) or measured by its steps, with a due date before the goal deadline; due dates in order within a track. Pass each existing id, or that milestone's steps are deleted. To change one milestone, use edit_milestone.

kind.description: count: progress is a recorded value against target ("talk to 20 people"); steps: progress is steps done ("implement the onboarding flow"), no metric needed. Default: count when metric and target are given, else steps; an existing milestone keeps its kind

trackId.description: the track this milestone belongs to (set_tracks); required for open milestones once the path has tracks

name: set_milestones
title: Set milestones
